nom: TULA 24-7 Power Swipe Hydrating Day & Night Treatment Eye Balm

avis.texte: I purchased this eye balm because of Stephanie Marie's recommendation. I always apply it on top of a hydrating toner, like the Manyo Essence Toner with Ectoin, which Ulta also sells, then apply my moisturizer. Sometimes ill also use a hydrating serum. Adding this product to those other products totally changed my undereye appearance with how much smoother my concealer and powder look! I'm 37 and for the past 2 years stuggled with my makeup looking creasy dry and cracked under my eyes…this eye balm is the factor that drastically improved the situation. It doesnt sting or burn my contact lenses and i use it AM and PM.

I bought this for the high amount of squalane and the caffeine. Unfortunately, I must be sensitive to one of the extracts because my eyes water the minute I put it on. also it itched a bit the first time. I only applied to my orbital bone with my finger. I guess it's just not for me :(

This product was life changing for me!! I just turned 30 and noticed myself developing fine lines under my eyes within the past few years. Never in a million years did I think this product would reverse that…I just got it mainly for hydration. But sure enough - 4 months later and my lines are GONE!!! I also have really sensitive skin and most eye products give me an allergic reaction but this one did not and is in fact soothing when I feel a little under eye skin irritation coming on. I hope Tula always keeps this product in their arsenal because I am now a lifetime customer!!!
I used up the whole tube, and although it feels nice on the skin, it felt like it didnt do much for me in the long run.

I've been using this as a light morning eye cream, and it's become an easy, reliable go‑to. The stick format glides on smoothly, absorbs quickly, and gives comfortable hydration without actives. It also works really well under makeup — no greasiness, no creasing. I'm a big fan of stick skincare, and this one doesn't disappoint. I treat it as an extra hydration boost rather than a treatment product, and I love that it's perfect for travel. Highly recommend for dry, sensitive skin if you want something simple, gentle, and makeup‑friendly.

This has been my favorite eye balm for years. Sometimes its the only thing I put on my when I go out. It feels soft on my face and does not make my skin sting. It hydrates ans gives my underye a subtle glow. My complaint is that it is much too stiff to apply directly under the eye. To apply, I rub it onto my ring finger to warm it up.

avis.titre: Surprising staple in winter skincare routine
avis.texte: This eye balm stick has become a surprise staple in my (46f) winter nighttime skincare routine. I apply it all over my face after serum and moisturizer. It locks the moisture in all night without stickiness or heaviness, and when I wake up my skin feels perfect. It doesn't break out my skin or clog pores. I need this extra step because the radiator makes the air so dry.

avis.titre: This is one of my favorit
avis.texte: This is one of my favorite face products! Moisturizers, tightens skin, and smooths wrinkles. I use it AM and PM after washing my face before I apply face moisturizer.

avis.titre: I love this product. It i
avis.texte: I love this product. It is literally a hydrating balm for your eyes. I use it multiple times a day. I just love the way it feels and the way it hydrates.

avis.titre: I wear this night and day
avis.texte: I wear this night and day. It's perfect under concealer to keep it looking smooth all day, and as extra moisture before bed. I don't go a day without it!
This product is a winner. I use it with makeup on or a clean face, anytime I feel a little tight or first thing in the morning. Leaves a very light, natural looking glow.

I have repurchased this so many times. It works to well to hydrate under my eyes and my eyelids which are eczema-prone. My only complaint is the price!! Wish it were more affordable since it only lasts about 2.5 months.
Leaves my under eyes so moisturized. I like using a night on alternating nights of the Tula Eye Recharge eye cream.
I had high hopes for this eye stick moisturizer, probably because it woyld begrest to travel with. However, never really moisturized my under eye area and dried out.

The formula is light-weight yet effective. The fine lines and dark circles are less noticeable. I love the tube, it's just the right amount of product, and it's perfect for travel. I bring it everywhere as needed.

avis.titre: Best on the go, by the be
avis.texte: Best on the go, by the bedside table moisturizer out there! I use it before I apply any makeup and use it right before I go to sleep. And it shows!

Got this as a gift in one of my purchases recently and the first night I used it I was so impressed because I woke up in the middle of the night and could feel it still absorbing into my face (not greasy or sticky but like I had recently applied) and by morning my under eye was more hydrated than ever! Looks like it'll last a long while too but I already plan to repurchase.
This eye balm is great. It glides on easily, feels super hydrating, and it so easy to use. I love the stick form as it keeps your hands mess free and it's easy to use even when you're super tired.
Absolutely love this purchase! I got it two days ago and plan to always have this in stock!

avis.titre: This is my second re orde
avis.texte: This is my second re order. So easy and quick to use and very moisturizing!

First time I tried this. I have had some health issues that have taken a toll on my skin/under eyes. This eye balm is amazing! I truly noticed a difference immediately! I use it daily and will continue to buy!! Thanks Tula!

avis.titre: One of the best I love th
avis.texte: One of the best I love this product really keeps moisture locked in your eye area.
I like this a lot! It's easy to use and a quick addition to my skin routine. I haven't seen much difference yet, but I enjoy using it
Very hydrating and convenient to carry with me and apply throughout the day.

avis.titre: Way too thick for an eye cream
avis.texte: The skin around the eyes is the thinnest on your face so using a product that drags and isn't super gentle isn't the best option. The cooling and brightening eye balm is a way better option in my opinion.

avis.titre: I am giving this five sta
avis.texte: I am giving this five stars because it works great I haven't found any other product.But Tula that works great under my eyes with totally recommend.

I honestly love how this feels applying this under eyes . It's a he's clean swipe that absorbs instantly It looks nice, it does, But, I noticed as the day went on, my eyes were burning and watering and red . Not an eye I'll use before going out. But at bedtime! Yes:)
I love how hydrated my eye area feels. I've seen the lines and puffiness diminish. Highly recommend

avis.titre: This is by far my best pr
avis.texte: This is by far my best product from Tula. It works great under my eyes. Keep it well hydrated and I just love it and I will keep re-ordering it.

I hate hate using under eye creams that come in a jar because i hate using my fingers to apply it. THIS has been the product that answered my prayers so i dont have to keep using under eye products that come in a jar. I love this eye balm so much im already on my 3rd tube!

avis.titre: So easy to just swipe on
avis.texte: So easy to just swipe on and doesn't feel heavy or greasy! It's like chap stick for your eyes only so much better! I will buy this again and again!

I suppose if hydration is the only goal that you have then this stick might be for you but I fell for the hype and paid for what to me is essentially eye chapstick. I've heard others say that they stopped using under eye concealer because of this product and that has definitely not been the case for me. I don't feel that this does anything for my eye area other than moisturize it, there is no effect on my dark circles or fine lines.

Bought maybe 2 weeks ago, used a handful of times, but each time I had to hold the balm so it wouldn't move. Yesterday evening, went to use it, and the whole balm fell out of the container. Doesnt look like it was packaged correctly, so didnt get to utilize this at all.

I use this day and night! It is so light I don't even realize its there once I walk away. I am starting to get fine lines around my eyes- I have to say that adding this to the other Tula products that I already use has helped!

I think i use this product a little differently than its intention but i love it nonetheless! I do indeed use it for extra moisture BUT i'd been searching for a good product to give me a dewy highlight without shimmer/mica and without leaving my skin feel oily, tacky, etc. this is it!!! It's very lightweight and adds a beautiful dewy highlight where you out it. I love that this is a skin care product that i can also include with a makeup look. I will for sure be buying this product again.

I do not like spending too much time on myself in the bathroom, so this balm is perfect for me! A couple of swipes and I'm done. When used as directed, the balm left the skin around my eyes hydrated and worked to get rid of those pesky small wrinkles. 10/10!!!!

hydrating day & night treatment eye balm, I use this every time I leave the house. I believe I can see a difference under my eyes after using. It is very moisturizing. I use it with the blue eye balm also or alone. I am currently purchasing again.:+1::skin-tone-5::+1::skin-tone-4::+1::skin-tone-6:

avis.titre: Moisturizes by the packaging is terrible
avis.texte: I was only able to use this a few times. It felt moisturizing and it didn't irritate me. However, the suction that happens when you take the cap off pulls the product out of the bottom of the tube. It happened everytime I used it. I forgot to be careful about opening it the fourth or so time I used it and the whole balm stick came out and fell on the floor :(
Finally something that works. (just like it says it will) Easy to use, great staying power and non irritating, worth every penny. Hallelujah!!!

This product contains lactic acid. It is not listed in the details or instructions that this product exfoliates! I noticed it was extoliating the skin around my eyes, so I had to checked the actual ingredint list, and then seen the lactic acid. It made the skin ariund my eyes thinner and I was follwing the instructuons that claimed you can use it safely twice a day. Who wants to exfoliate the delicate and thin skin around their eyes? Not me. I would sue this company if I could. People need to be warned and notified when putting products that exfoliate anywhere on thier face, especially on the eye and neck area since those areas have the thinnest skin on the entire body. Almost everything in the entire Tula brand exfoliates. How much skin does the lady who created this brand think that we have? She must have the thickest skin in the world, if she can handle using all of this stuff on her face every single day.

This hydrating day & night eye balm has been a wonderful addition to my simple skin care routine. It goes on with ease and as you swipe it under your eyes, it glides smoothly and doesn't tug on your skin! Definitely a must have for me!!

Bought few months back ran out and I could tell a difference even at my age (69) I'm not trying to look 40 yrs younger but when my eyes seeing a difference once I ran out of product I knew I had to continue. Not to mention how easy the application is too.
Love this! So hydrating and refreshing. I can tell a huge difference in the appearance of my undereyes just after a few weeks! Will be repurchasing.

It's SO moisturizing and the stuck moves effortlessly across the tender skin below the eye. My concealer goes easier, too. I use it above my upper lip and anywhere that is very dry, too! My dark circles seem to be getting a little better, but I've only been using it for about a week. I will update when I see how it does after a few weeks. The only thing I will mention is that in order to feel the cooling effect of the other Tula under eye balms/products, I must put those on first, and then put the moisturizer on second; otherwise, it blocks the effect of the other products. I guess that's a good thing because it means there's a nice protective coating of moisture! I do recommend!

When I first used the Power Swipe, I wasn't sure how I felt about it. But THEN, I put it on at night for a few night, and noticed that I didn't even need concealer in the mornings. I was refreshed! So it's with me at all times and has replaced under eye concealer, for me. I struggled with puffiness and dark circles, but little Power Swipe balm has changed the game for my under eyes. Throughout the day, a little swipe is the perfect pick-me-up and refresher. I didn't like the texture at first, but it is essential to my routine now.
Love this stuff. I wear it everyday! Love how it glides on easily and refreshes my eyes
I apply to my under eye area following my nightly skin care routine and have definitely noticed a difference.

avis.titre: First time trying and liking so far
avis.texte: Have been really liking this! Goes on easily with the stick. Glad I got during sale.
I love how this is so hydrating and it's also convenient ! love it :heart_eyes:
Love this stuff! So soothing, I haven't had dried out skin around my eye since using this, I would have that often. And seems like the wrinkles under my bottom lashes have faded a bit as well!
I love this product!! My eyes have never looked so good. Tula is amazing.
This brightens the eye area and gives amazing results! I just love the wait it makes my under eyes glow!

I bought the 3 pack for your eye area, the white one, pink and blue. I just started using the white one and went to open it and the whole thing fell out onto the floor. So that will go in the garbage since I have a service animal and I am not using something with hair all over it. SUPER DISAPPOINTMENT AND WASTE OF MONEY.
Moisturizing and smoothing. This product is also quick and easy to use.

It's hydrating, absorbs quickly, and works well under makeup. Still, after about a month, I didn't feel like it did anything fantastic for my dark circles or puffiness. I do like the stick form; it will be excellent for traveling.

avis.titre: Easy to apply and feels AMAZING!
avis.texte: Apply in the am and pm. It has the idea of a lipstick roll - anyone can do it! Under my eyes look and feel great! I have super sensitive skin and get no reaction from it.
Feels great around my eyes. Definitely helping with my fine lines.
I apply this everywhere I don't put rose glow. Warding off the crows feet so far.

I thought I would love this and that it would be easy to apply, but I really don't like it. It dried up quickly and I feel like I'm pulling on the delicate skin around my eyes just to have nothing go on them. I feel like the risks outweigh the potential benefits of using this product. I wish I could return it.

great, easy treatment with good results. i like it mostly because i can use it on the go. i dont have to wait for anything to dry and it doesn't fel sticky after application. i can even put it in my purse for use of the go. i dont feel the need to wear concealer anymore.

Very hydrating under the eyes. I like to use it under makeup because it helps my concealer to not crease. Helped with under eye darkness. Love to swipe trails under and around my eyes at night and in the morning!
My under eyes are extremely dry and flake very easily. I have been using this product for almost 2 year and I have not had dry or flaky under eyes since.
Good texture but may has issue with combination with another moisturizer and/or sunscreen. Using as a solo may be a good idea. However, I don't see visual improvement particularly under eyes.
I'm 57 so always looking for a miracle. This balm felt quite nice on but didn't make any noticeable difference to my under eye are. Plus as a contact lens wearer it wandered too easily onto my lens.
Amazing product! At 54 I need products that will nourish and wake up my skin! I highly recommend Tula! It's my now go to skin care!
I love this eye balm,much better than a cream. Easy to apply and has definitely helped my eyes under the brows.

Refreshes the eye area and feels soothing on my skin which can sometimes get irritated by skin care products. Love the stick applicator. So fast to swipe under my eyes after cleansing. Worth a try if you are tempted!
This balm is so light weight you don't even feel like you are wearing anything. So refreshing
It has helped so much with dark circles under my eyes, its so fine has no odor and a perfect smooth finish.

avis.titre: Easy to apply…doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes
avis.texte: So far I love how easily this goes on! Doesn't feel greasy or heavy around my normally sensitive eyes. I did notice a little reduction in puffiness and fine lines. Time will tell if it continues to improve.
Dark circles have massively reduced, it's a brilliant product
Easy to use, like the glide application. Goes on clear and dries quickly. Use it daily as base for eye care regimen.

This is a nice product. I like the convenience of a balm. It is hydrating and the under eye looks more supple, less dry and saggy. As far as long term results, can't comment on the look of lines or aging, I've only been using it about a month. I also use the brightening and cooling balm and I like that product as well. I will repurchase once I have used it all.
Absolutely love this product. I've been using it for about a month now and my eye area is super hydrated!
This eyebalm is amazing, my under eyes are always so dry and this balm brings them back to life!
So far I line it. Seems to be hydrating my eye area, but it's not the only product I use.

I've been using this for a few months now. I love how it feels when I apply it. It's not heavy and definitely hydrates my skin. I'm not sure it does much for wrinkles and dark circles though. It may just take more time to notice results. I'll keep trying it for a while.
In love with this product! I have noticed a huge different to the bags under my eyes already with using this!
This product works great with reducing under eye puffiness and fine lines! A great purchase!
Love the eye treatments that I got - they are easy to use, Super moisturizing and hold their moisture. Most importantly they are clean.
Easy to use-like lip balm for the under eyes! Helps hydrate, brighten, and protect my under eye area from the intense dry, WTX sun. Love this well priced product!!

I have no idea if it's really working or not for wrinkles, but it feels great on and keeps my under eyes moisturized all day. It's so easy to use so I find myself more likely to use it than other eye treatments. Will re-order.

avis.titre: I never write reviews, this is 10/10!
avis.texte: I have very genuinely prominent dark circles and hollowness. This is the only eye product that has ever made any visual difference on me. I am in the 'younger' category but I have fine lines and eye fatigue + this brightens the bags + smooths lines
I leave this in my mini fridge in the bathroom. It feels great when I swipe it on, morning & night. I've used for a full week and can tell I've got brighter eyes!!

Seriously love this product. I've always struggled with dry eyes, making it hard to apply any type of eye make up without it looking flakey. After using this product, my eyes have become so much more moisturized and healthy. I can now actually wear eye makeup! I highly recommend trying this product out.

I wasn't sure about this-I've been searching for a good eye product for so long, I've tried tons. This seems so lightweight, and non-greasy that I am shocked it works. Most eye cream geared towards wrinkles and effects of aging are heavy and greasy. This stick is light, gives a glow, and absorbs. And even better? I noticed a difference within a couple of days. The lines around my eyes seem smoother and less noticeable. I use it morning and night, and in the daytime I apply a little of the rose glow stick to brighten. It works! My only gripe is that the stick is smaller than the rose and cooling sticks.

avis.titre: Tugs under eyes too much to use
avis.texte: I have the blue Tula stick and I love it. That one goes on like butter. This white one is very firm and does not glide on the skin. I wanted it for hydration for the fine lines and wrinkles- I'm definitely not going to use it when it pulls that delicate skin.
I have dark circles and saw someone promoting this. I tried it for a good while trying to make it work. The only thing I noticed were headaches. I didn't notice any change of my under eye.

Early days into using, but once on feels nice & non greasy. A little hard to apply around the eye area from the applicator as balm is in hard stick form. So around soft eye area I now use by gently patting area with balm applied to finger tips. Leaves eyes feeling good & looking good.
Its okay I have not seen a big difference but then my eyes might not have been that bad to start off with

avis.titre: Does not burn my eyes and moisturizes well
avis.texte: I tried a lot of products for my puffy eyes and this does not burn my eyes and my fine lines appear more smooth. I have been using for about a week and will continue to use, no breakouts either which is nice.

I want to love this product because I love Tula but I feel like this is either the wrong product for me. The product doesn't absorb into my skin. it feels like it just sits on top of the skin leaving the area around my eyes very greasy. I cannot wear any mascara when i have this eye cream on because the eye cream is so greasy it takes my mascara right off. Maybe I just need to find a better eye cream for my skin type, especially with the money I spent on the hydrating eye balm.
